items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Well he used to follow me and Chook all the time. Used to carry Chook on with me.

ctx.x: Louis, Yank was playing for Louis.
Yank was playing for Louis. Well he used to follow me and Chook all the time. Used to carry Chook on with me. Everywhere we go, we call him Yank. He used to carry with it.

Yeah, you see his name was Oliver I believe. No. Oh, what that boy name is. Uh-uh. You remember when the, when the, when they had Paducah in them up there, Yank was learning playing horned in. When the, Sweevers would come here and played, uh. Played ball. Played. Car Lake and them up there. You know. Yank was playing. Playing horned in. On that horned in.
